verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "Lilies." Of David. Save me, God, because the water has come up to my neck!
I am sinking in deep mud, and there is nowhere to stand. I have gone into deep water, and the flood is sweeping over me.
I am worn out from crying for help. My throat is dry. My eyes are tired from looking for my God.
Those who hate me for no reason are more than the hairs on my head. Many powerful enemies want to destroy me for no reason. I am forced to give back what I did not steal.
God, you know how foolish I have been. My sins are not hidden from you.
Lord GOD of Armies, do not let those who hope in you be put to shame because of me. God of Israel, do not let those who look for you be disgraced because of me.
I have been insulted because of you. Shame covers my face.
I have become a stranger to my own brothers, a foreigner to my mother's children.
My deep love for your house burns inside me like a fire. The insults of those who insult you have fallen on me.
When I cried and went without food, they insulted me for it.
When I wore rough clothes of sadness, people made jokes about me.
Those who sit at the city gate talk about me. Drunks make up songs about me.
But LORD, I pray to you at the time you choose to show kindness. God, because of your great and faithful love, answer me with your sure rescue.
Pull me out of the mud. Do not let me sink. Rescue me from those who hate me and from the deep waters.
Do not let the floodwaters sweep over me. Do not let the deep water swallow me up. Do not let the pit close its mouth over me.
Answer me, LORD, because your faithful love is good. Because of your great mercy, turn to me.
Do not hide your face from me, your servant, because I am in trouble. Answer me quickly!
Come near and rescue me. Set me free from my enemies.
You know how I am insulted, shamed, and disgraced. You see all my enemies.
Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for someone to feel sorry for me, but there was no one. I looked for someone to comfort me, but I found no one.
They put poison in my food. When I was thirsty, they gave me sour wine to drink.
Let their own table become a trap for them. Let it become their punishment and a snare.
Let their eyes be darkened so they cannot see. Let their backs always be bent with trouble.
Pour out your anger on them. Let your burning anger catch up with them.
Let their homes be left empty. Let no one live in their tents.
They attack the person you have already wounded. They talk about the pain of those you have hurt.
Add one crime after another to their record. Do not let them share in your goodness.
Let their names be wiped out of the book of life. Do not let them be listed with good people.
But I am in pain and distress. God, let your saving power protect me.
I will praise God's name with a song. I will honour him with thanks.
This will please the LORD more than offering an ox, or a bull with its horns and hoofs.
Humble people will see it and be glad. You who look for God, let your hearts be encouraged.
The LORD hears those in need. He does not look down on his people who are prisoners.
Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and everything that moves in them!
God will save Zion and rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will settle there and own the land.
The children of his servants will receive it. Those who love his name will live there.
